purpose: Non-P0, rubric-bound quality signals after comparison with human gold decisions.

criteria.description: Research depth and response length are proportional to the task.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Blinded scenario input, output, and tool summary.
criteria.passCondition: One atomic judgment cites observable output evidence.

criteria.description: The output separates evidence, interpretation, uncertainty, and proposed action.
criteria.passCondition: Each category is distinguishable without relying on hidden reasoning.

criteria.description: The output is concise and usable in an independent recruiter workflow.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Blinded structured output and atomic rubric.
criteria.passCondition: The judgment cites a specific observable phrase or field.
